messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-4521 - inference-queue-prod backlog > 12000 msgs, avg dequeue latency 8.7s, autoscaler scaling rate < expected.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident created and page sent to primary on-call. @jordan_oncall paged.
jordan_oncall: Acked PD-4521. I'm on it. Quick check: are we seeing node provisioning failures in the cloud logs?
mira_sre: Seeing repeated 'quota exceeded' errors from cloud provider for gpu-pool-provision calls starting 4399989900. K8s shows HPA desired=48 current=12.
devon_infra: Confirmed cloud returned 429s on instance create. Looks like regional quota hit for nvidia-a100 in us-west-2.
jordan_oncall: Ok. Runbook 'autoscale-backlog' step 1: try manual scale to warm pool, step 2: fallback routing. I'm going to start manual spin up and route low-priority customers to dedicated-fallback.
jordan_oncall: Running: ```redwoodctl scale --pool inference-prod-warm --size 40 --type gpu-a100```
liz_ops: Noted. Sending a templated notification to affected customers (low qps tiers) to degrade non-critical batches. Draft: "We are seeing elevated inference latency due to capacity provisioning delays; we are throttling background jobs to restore service." Want to send?
mira_sre: While that runs, enable temporary prefix caching and KV reuse for heavy chat sessions — reduces token load. Patch applied: cache TTL extended, should cut throughput ~18%.
devon_infra: Manual spin-up hit cloud quota. Requesting quota increase with provider support but ETA ~45-60 mins.
jordan_oncall: Given quota lag, pivot to fallbacks. Updating routing policy: route request class 'best-effort' -> smaller quantized model (gpt-small-q4) and apply response size limit. Applying now.
jordan_oncall: ```/ops/routes update --selector best-effort --model gpt-small-q4 --rate-limit 50rps```
mira_sre: Metrics: queue length trending down slowly (12000 -> 8200 over 3m) after cache+fallback. Dequeue latency 8.7s -> 5.1s. Still above SLO.
liz_ops: Sent customer note to 6 accounts on higher noise; one reply already acknowledging.
devon_infra: Opening emergency support case with cloud, sent account contact and quota justification. Also requesting cross-region spin-up as a short term (us-east-1) — may need model registry push.
jordan_oncall: I'll coordinate cross-region failover: mira, can you validate model variants are available in us-east and that routing supports region fallback?
mira_sre: Models present in us-east. We need to warm weights for the quantized variant; pushing artifacts now (estimated 4-6m).
jordan_oncall: Creating incident channel and notes: https://redwood.incidents/PD-4521. Tagging SRE lead. If queue backlogs drop to <2k and latency <2s for 10m, we'll mark as mitigated.
pd-bot: PD-4521 acknowledged by jordan_oncall. Escalation policy not triggered.
liz_ops: FYI finance alert: cost may spike if cross-region spin-ups proceed. Approving emergency spend for now.
mira_sre: Warmup complete in us-east for gpt-small-q4. Enabling region fallback for 20% of traffic to reduce pressure.
jordan_oncall: Routing change applied. Observing queue length 8200 -> 2600 over 6m, dequeue latency 5.1s -> 2.3s. Good improvement.
devon_infra: Cloud support replied: quota increase is approved but will take 27m to provision. We should be able to scale back cross-region after that.
jordan_oncall: I'll start scaling down cross-region after quota available and verify no residual backlog. Preparing handoff: @mira_sre will take next 30m watch then hand to @devon_infra for quota follow-up.
mira_sre: Taking watch. I'll post a short status update in 15m and capture mitigation steps in incident doc.
jordan_oncall: Handing off now. Thanks all. Closing real-time page but leaving incident open for postmortem. :thumbsup:
